o.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian تَنْقِید (tanqīd), a pseudo-Arabism from the root ن ق د (n q d).
From Persian عصیانگر ('esyângar), from Arabic عِصْيَان (ʕiṣyān, “disobedience”). By surface analysis, üsyan + -kar.
Borrowed from Armenian գոմեշ (gomeš). Doublet of camış.
